future_picture: Young people in Nova Scotia build fulfilling lives — whether in emerging industries or established trades, in entrepreneurial ventures or community services, in technology or the arts — drawn to stay or return by a welcoming province where diverse communities thrive and quality of life rivals any region in Canada or beyond.
